author: lordteddey
body:
Howdy there, well, as should be obvious, I'd like to appeal my infraction. I've held up just about 2 months since my past appeal and I do trust that I am a changed man. I believe I've been less toxic then before and developed to become a mature and very much mannered man! I've been contributing towards subjects on the forums and have been entirely pleasant on TeamSpeak. All things considered, I can guarantee to keep abiding the rules at all times and assist the community by doing great deeds. I trust I ought to be conceded this one opportunity to demonstrate that I am a changed man. Much thanks to you and ideally you mull over my allure.

Yours sincerely,
Mr Ambivalence the Lion heart

title: Ambi's Appeal folks!

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

After reviewing your infractions, I've decided to appeal your infraction. I believe that you've waited an appropriate amount of time; thus, you'll be appealed. However, keep in mind your appeal has barely got appected, meaning if you break rules again, you will be banned with no chance of appealing.

Thanks!
